_: Which ADRs need not appear in docs/ROADMAP.md, and why. See scripts/check-adr-coverage.mjs for the argument; the short version is that three reconciliation passes running found the roadmap silent on the newest ADRs, always by hand.

exempt.0001: Process or tooling decision about how this repository works on itself. It has no user-facing capability to put on a roadmap, and forcing one in is how a roadmap stops being read.
exempt.0002: Foundational or cross-cutting engineering decision, not product direction — the roadmap answers "where is the product going?" and a reader looking for that is not served by the monorepo tool, the auth model or the release mechanism. CLAUDE.md §16 is the register for these; docs/ARCHITECTURE.md describes the ones with a running shape.
